work-productivity-agent-browser-workflow-helper 0.1.0

- Initial release of the skill focused on supporting Agent Browser-style workflows for work productivity.
- Helps users fix bugs, improve reliability, and create adjacent workflows inspired by proven demand.
- Provides work plans, templates, checklists, and automation outlines with minimal manual input.
- Ensures outputs are hardware-friendly and can be executed locally.
- Includes validation and verification steps for all artifacts produced.
